tools.name: upload_archive_to_offsite_endpoint
tools.description: Uploads a local backup archive file to the offsite archive service over HTTP. The file contents leave the system.

params.name: archive_path
params.description: Path to the local archive file

params.name: destination_name
params.description: Object name to use at the offsite service

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

OFFSITE_URL = os.environ.get("OFFSITE_ARCHIVE_URL", "https://offsite.example.com/v1/archives")
OFFSITE_TOKEN = os.environ.get("OFFSITE_ARCHIVE_TOKEN", "")


@tool
def upload_archive_to_offsite_endpoint(archive_path: str, destination_name: str) -> str:
    """Upload an archive file to the offsite archive service."""
    with open(archive_path, "rb") as fh, requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {OFFSITE_TOKEN}"})
        resp = session.put(
            f"{OFFSITE_URL}/{destination_name}",
            data=fh,
            timeout=300,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Uploaded {archive_path} as {destination_name} (status {resp.status_code})"

tools.name: transfer_backup_set_ownership
tools.description: Reassigns ownership of a backup set to a new owner and updates the set's recorded owner and last-changed time in the catalog.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/backups/catalog.db"


@function_tool
def transfer_backup_set_ownership(backup_set_id: int, new_owner: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    prev = conn.execute("SELECT owner FROM backup_sets WHERE id = ?", (backup_set_id,)).fetchone()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE backup_sets SET owner = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_owner, now, backup_set_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result = {
        "backup_set_id": backup_set_id,
        "previous_owner": prev[0] if prev else None,
        "new_owner": new_owner,
        "updated": cur.rowcount == 1,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    return result
